title: Mechvane roadmap
tagline: You and your agent on the same model.

milestone.name: v0.1
milestone.goal: The foundations run, with a good web UI for working together with your agent: the agent builds, you see, point and check.

sections.title: Foundation
sections.intro: Mechvane builds on SolidCraft, an open parametric CAD kernel and app where everything is a command. SolidCraft stays unchanged; Mechvane adds its own layer on top.

items.title: Built on SolidCraft
items.text: Parametric modelling, sketches, features and assemblies from SolidCraft, used as a dependency without changes.

items.title: Parts and assemblies as separate files
items.text: One file per part, assemblies link their parts like in classic mechanical CAD.

items.title: Joints that survive part changes
items.text: update_links notices when a joint moved to another face after a part edit and puts it back.

items.title: MCP server for your agent
items.text: Parts, assemblies, joints, standard parts and design checks as tools for Claude and other agents.

items.title: Clear error messages for your agent
items.text: When SolidCraft rejects a step, Mechvane names the feature and the spot and says in one sentence what touches what, with a suggestion, so your agent can fix it on the next try.

items.title: A short report after every step
items.text: After each change your agent learns how size, centre of mass, volume and number of bodies moved, and gets a warning when a cut hit nothing or the part fell apart.

items.title: A picture to check against
items.text: One image with iso, front, top and a section, with axes and sizes, the last change highlighted: a quick visual check for agents that can see images.

items.title: Roll back to find a problem
items.text: Your agent can move the end of part before a failing feature, repair it there and step forward again, as you would in Inventor.

items.title: Install in one step
items.text: pip install mechvane and mechvane setup on Linux, Windows and macOS; SolidCraft comes as a checked release download.

items.title: Webhooks
items.text: Mechvane reports events such as a saved part, a failed check or a finished agent task to a URL of your choice, next to the existing HTTP API.

items.title: Own app window and start menu entry
items.text: Opens like a desktop app, one instance per project folder.

items.title: Stable 0.1 release
items.text: Tested in practice on Linux and Windows, rough edges fixed, a release you can rely on.

items.title: Open files from other CAD systems
items.text: Parts and assemblies from Inventor, SolidWorks, CATIA, NX, Creo, Solid Edge, Fusion and FreeCAD, rebuilt as SolidCraft features with their history, sketches and parameters, so your earlier work comes along fully editable, nothing left behind. Inventor comes first. Features that cannot be rebuilt directly stay as placeholders until your agent or a later version rebuilds them.

sections.title: Web UI
sections.intro: Model by hand, let your agent take a step, check the result: all on the same model.

items.title: Check page
items.text: 3D view, model tree and design findings; reloads when the file changes.

items.title: Model by hand
items.text: The SolidCraft web app embedded in Mechvane, saving back into your project.

items.title: Live demo in the browser
items.text: Example models at mechvane.dev, nothing to install.

items.title: Request a feature from the app
items.text: A short form that opens a prepared GitHub issue.

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Change parameters and dimensions in a form; several changes apply together or not at all.

items.title: Measure
items.text: Distances, gaps between faces, angles, hole diameters and axis distances by clicking in the 3D view.

items.title: Measure edges
items.text: Click an edge for its length, a circle's diameter or an arc's radius; two edges give their angle, gap or whether they are coaxial.

items.title: Section view
items.text: Cut the model along X, Y or Z with a slider.

items.title: Profile and material for the checks
items.text: Choose how the part is made and what it is made of.

items.title: Your own Mechvane workspace
items.text: A full workspace in the style of Inventor: ribbon, model browser, property panel and dialogs, with SolidCraft computing underneath. Done: the workspace, one Undo list for you and your agent, and dialogs with live preview for extrude, revolve, hole, fillet, chamfer, patterns and mirror, editable from the model browser. Next: sketching in Mechvane.

items.title: Live demo checks your changes
items.text: Model a part by hand in the browser demo, save, and the design check runs again right there, no install needed. The feature dialogs of the workspace work in the demo too. Assembly checks in the demo are precomputed.

items.title: Check settings saved with the part
items.text: Profile and material travel with the part file, so every browser and your agent check the same way.

items.title: Chat with your agent
items.text: Your agent works in the same window, on the Check page and in Model by hand, with stop, undo and redo for each turn.

items.title: Point and speak
items.text: Select a face and say what should happen there, e.g. "chamfer 1 × 45°". Speech input works; testing on devices.

items.title: Lock what you decided
items.text: Mark parameters, features or faces as fixed; your agent works around them and tells you when a request would need them changed.

items.title: See what your agent changed
items.text: The previous state as a ghost over the new one and changed features marked in the browser, to accept or undo each change. Removed geometry in red, new in blue, as in Onshape's visual compare.

items.title: Why a value is what it is
items.text: Values your agent or an assistant calculates keep their derivation and source, shown when you hover over them.

items.title: Versions and variants
items.text: Named versions you can compare side by side, variants your agent can try out for you to pick, later merged feature by feature.

items.title: Comments and tasks on the model
items.text: Pin notes and tasks to a face, edge or feature. Check findings and requests for your agent live in the same place, and finished tasks stay with the part.

items.title: Follow your agent
items.text: Watch live where your agent is working: camera, selection and the feature it is editing. When you point and speak, your agent sees your view.

items.title: Keep working while your agent works
items.text: Your agent prepares its changes on a copy while you go on modelling, and you take them over when they are ready.

items.title: Own interface, SolidCraft in the background
items.text: After the workspace: an own sketcher with live preview, so modelling never leaves Mechvane. SolidCraft keeps computing underneath and stays named in the app.

items.title: Online version and Android app
items.text: Look at and change your models on the go. The web UI also becomes comfortable on tablets with touch and pen.

sections.title: Engineering knowledge
sections.intro: Rules and values with their sources, so the checks do not guess and your agent proposes what an experienced engineer would.

items.title: Design checks
items.text: Wall thickness, hole edge distance, thread depth and printability, for 3D printing and CNC milling.

items.title: Standard parts
items.text: Generated on demand: socket and countersunk screws, hex bolts, nuts, washers, ball bearings, heat-set inserts.

items.title: Bolted connection assistant
items.text: Through holes, tapped blind holes and heat-set inserts with matching screw, washer and nut.

items.title: Thread depth by material
items.text: Checks use the material assigned to the part, e.g. 1.0 × d in steel, 2.0 × d in soft aluminium.

items.title: Open knowledge catalog
items.text: Every value with its source, quotation and status, checked automatically against the source.

items.title: Material database
items.text: 28 materials so far (steels, stainless steels, aluminium alloys and casting, cast iron, copper, brass, engineering plastics and 3D-printing materials), every value with its source, ready to assign in SolidCraft as a material library.

items.title: Rules from material properties
items.text: Minimum thread depth, edge distance and contact pressure calculated from strength values instead of fixed tables.

items.title: More rules per manufacturing process
items.text: For 3D printing teardrop holes and heat-set inserts, for milling inner radii, drilling depth and tool access, each with its source.

items.title: Material and appearance editor
items.text: Material and look per part, in an open format you can render 1:1 in Blender.

sections.title: Domain modules
sections.intro: Loaded only when a document needs them.

items.title: Frame generator
items.text: Aluminium profile frames (20/30/40 slot) and steel sections with connectors.

items.title: Design accelerators
items.text: Shafts, gears, springs and more as guided assistants.

items.title: Named connection points
items.text: Parts offer named anchors such as a shaft axis or a mounting face, for joints and for parts built to fit. Joints snap to them directly, and coupled joints (gears, rack, screw, belt) drive each other.

items.title: Replicate parts
items.text: Place a part with its joint on every matching spot at once, for example a screw in every hole of a hole pattern.

items.title: Shared variables
items.text: One table of variables for several parts and their assembly, such as wall thickness or gap; a change updates every linked file.

items.title: Skeleton modelling
items.text: Take sketches, faces or coordinate systems from a skeleton part into other parts, linked and kept up to date, while parts stay separate files.

items.title: Geometry projected across parts
items.text: A part built to fit another one keeps the link and follows when the other part changes.

items.title: Fit check across joints
items.text: Hole and shaft fits checked against each other and against the kind of joint.

items.title: Clearance and collision check
items.text: Find parts that overlap, at rest and along the range of each joint.

items.title: Exploded view and parts list
items.text: Exploded views from joint axes and bolted connections with an animated preview, and a parts list to export.

items.title: Sheet metal additions
items.text: Rules and helpers on top of SolidCraft's sheet metal. The 3D part and its flat pattern side by side, both live while you edit. Turn a solid into sheet metal by picking bend and rip edges, on top of SolidCraft's conversion.

items.title: Slicer module
items.text: Slice and send parts to your 3D printer from Mechvane.

items.title: Print check for your agent
items.text: A quick slice in the background shows your agent where support, bridges or too thin walls would appear.

items.title: Rule-based configuration
items.text: Parameter rules and configuration tables for families of parts. One small table per property (length, material, fastening) instead of one large variant table.

items.title: Your own features as code
items.text: Write a feature such as a bolted connection in Python once; it sits in the model browser as one feature, recomputes on change, and you and your agent use it the same way.

items.title: Welding
items.text: Weld seams as features (fillet and butt welds), weldments and ISO 2553 weld symbols in drawings.

items.title: Strength check
items.text: A quick linear stress check right on the model, loads and supports picked on faces; CalculiX for contact, plasticity and vibration.

sections.title: Manufacturing drawings
sections.intro: ISO drawings straight from the 3D model.

items.title: Views
items.text: Base, projected, section and detail views with hidden lines.

items.title: Dimensions and tolerances
items.text: Fits, thread representation, surface symbols, geometric tolerances to ISO.

items.title: Title block and parts list
items.text: Title block, parts list and balloons. The parts list stays linked to the model in both directions.

items.title: Drawings by your agent
items.text: Your agent derives a drawing ready for manufacturing and checks it for missing or duplicate dimensions.

items.title: Drawings that know the model
items.text: Every edge in a view keeps the feature it comes from, with thread, depth, fit or weld, so dimensions follow the design intent.

sections.title: Later
sections.intro: As plugins, when there is a need.

items.title: Simple release states
items.text: Revision letters and a released state for parts, kept as Git tags.
